subject.title: Switcher rows “Weekly progress” uses the primary/session quota

question: Should the combined-menu switcher’s existing “Weekly progress” option mean a provider’s weekly quota whenever available, or should it intentionally represent the primary/session quota under a renamed or configurable option?
rationale: Commit 11f4cc8d intentionally favored primary quotas, but the current localized label still promises weekly behavior; source inspection cannot determine which user-facing contract should win.

options.title: Restore weekly semantics
options.body: Prefer a provider’s weekly/secondary window for this setting and fall back to primary only when no weekly window exists.

options.title: Keep primary semantics
options.body: Retain primary/session quota selection, rename the option to describe that behavior, and consider a separate per-provider metric control.

recommendation.title: Restore weekly semantics
recommendation.body: Prefer a provider’s weekly/secondary window for this setting and fall back to primary only when no weekly window exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the intentional historical behavior change make this the most likely product-direction route.
